collision_check: find prop-*.fbx across studio art + rg drawknife: only prop-drawknife-pg1 exists; no prop-drawknife-blade*/handle*/ferrule*/tang* and no -dk1 names; all 4 names free
judgment_calls: Ferrule is a 6-sided hollow ring (48 tris) - soft overrun of the 16-tri preference; a closed ring with thickness cannot be made under 16 tris without losing the bore. Well under 210 hard max.
Blade blank uses a rhombus cross-section so both long edges are bevelled; tang stubs are triangular-section to keep 26 tris.
Tang pin is square-section stock (12 tris) rather than round to meet the 12-tri budget.
Handle is a tapered hexagonal blank (20 tris).
